scientific_conclusion: This package supplies one exact, strongly registered colour-chart observation spanning a Lumix S5II RAW capture and a Portra 400 to Fuji DPii print scan. It is adequate only for a development-only explicit-operator discriminant with held patches and wrong-pair controls. One session, one roll, unknown processing and an uncalibrated scanner/print chain cannot identify a stock response; the natural images remain independent future confirmation candidates rather than training targets.
